sam_csm: Cedar Grove (ANZ pilot) needs a last-minute demo window 2026-07-15 09:30 NZST. Request: temporary edge allowlist for partner NATs, route qps bump to 1750, mTLS client cert pinning, and NZ region lock. cc @ivy_sre @harry_net

ivy_sre: Copy. Two quick asks: public CIDRs and bursty vs sustained? If sustained we should reserve small Dedicated capacity.

harry_net: Partner provided 203.0.116.12/32 and 203.0.116.13/32. Traffic is bursty (short gen calls). They want SNI pin to demo.cedargrove.ai.

june_legal: Legal OK with 24h temp access; require logs to stay in nz-south and certs stored with KMS in nz-south.

ops_bot: Policy: temp allowlists max 72h. CLI examples:
redwoodctl allowlist create --name cedar-temp --cidrs 203.0.116.12/32,203.0.116.13/32 --expires 2026-07-16T05:30:00Z --regions nz-south --note "Cedar Grove demo; auto-revoke"
redwoodctl route update --route cedargrove-demo --qps 1750 --region_pin nz-south

ivy_sre: Applying allowlist AL-13021 and canarying mTLS verify change. Will set alert suppression for CS-5309 (non-P0 only). Rollback if error rate>4% or p95>300ms.

sam_csm: Thanks — I'll tell the customer and include rollback criteria. Please ping when live so I can update account health / renewal notes.

ops_bot: Allowlist applied AL-13021 (203.0.116.12/32,203.0.116.13/32). Route override cedargrove-demo qps=1750 region_pin=nz-south. Auto-revoke scheduled.

ivy_sre: Canary passed; rolling to prod in 2m. Links saved to CS-5309.

sam_csm: Great work, leaving a renewal note: fast provisioning is positive. Closing loop unless extension required. :tada:
